threshold_basis.constant_lengths: Skeletal segments have no intended scaling;5e-5 is a floating-point tolerance, not a proportion adjustment.
threshold_basis.midshaft: These sections lie away from intended short elbow/wrist/shoulder blend zones. Their geometry should behave almost as a rigid segment. A5% area/width loss or5mm centerline departure is an explicit collapse/curvature rejection.
threshold_basis.cloth_degeneracy: A regular face with at least2mm rest altitude that loses90% of its area is close to a line and cannot preserve its authored fabric patch. This is a catastrophic-collapse check, not a model of cloth elasticity.
threshold_basis.strain: Principal stretches and area-weighted percentiles are reported without an invented cotton/twill material limit. Long folds, construction seams and thin trim need visual interpretation.

limits: Every integer frame and midpoint is measured; no claim is made for arbitrary unsampled times.
The cloth is a skinned game mesh, not a cloth simulation.
Cross-sectional hull areas describe silhouette and are not watertight anatomical volumes.
Passing these checks does not replace the separate exact intersection audit or visual frame inspection.
